rows.note: This is the colloquial all-purpose choice for the group of undergarments worn under outer clothes, especially underpants and bras.

example.english: Pack your underwear first; don't forget it when we go to the beach tomorrow.
example.traditional: 執好底衫褲先，聽日去沙灘唔好唔記得。
example.jyutping: zap1 hou2 dai2 saam1 fu3 sin1 ting1 jat6 heoi3 saa1 taan1 m4 hou2 m4 gei3 dak1

rows.note: Use this as a neutral general term when the particular undergarments are not being specified.

example.english: I'm packing the underwear I need for my trip.
example.traditional: 我執緊旅行要帶嘅內衣。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zap1 gan2 leoi5 hang4 jiu3 daai3 ge3 noi6 ji1

rows.note: Use this for the upper-body underwear or undershirt part of the clothing worn next to the skin.

example.english: It's so hot, your underwear is completely soaked.
example.traditional: 咁熱，你件底衫都濕晒喇。
example.jyutping: gam3 jit6 nei5 gin6 dai2 saam1 dou1 sap1 saai3 laa3
